<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/user/{realm}/userRealmRoles/{userId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns realm-level role names assigned to one user. Without read-admin permission, callers may retrieve only their own roles. The target realm must be active unless the caller is a superuser.
